newsitem.title: UK: Intl Greetings predicts bumper Xmas.
newsitem.headline: Intl Greetings predicts bumper Xmas.

text.p: International Greetings Plc, British-based designer and manufacturer of wrapping paper and greeting cards, said on Tuesday it was quite bullish about Christmas this year and was looking for growth to surpass last year's festive season.

The company, which supplies cards, wrapping paper and Christmas crackers to major retailers such as Boots Co Plc and Woolworths, said its order books supported the view that it would have a good Christmas.
Joint chief executive Nick Fisher said the group was well into manufacturing for the Christmas season, which accounts for 80 percent of its turnover.
"Last Christmas was very strong," he said by telephone, "We're looking for larger growth than last year."

The company, which listed on the Alternative Investment Market in October 1995, reported a 58 percent increase in pretax profits for the year to March 31 1997, to 5.1 million stg. Earnings per share rose 57 percent to 26 pence and the dividend by 33 percent to 6.67 pence.
Turnover increased to 48.4 million stg, from 44.2 million.
Fisher said the group, which also has operations in the United States and is expanding into Europe, was on the look out for acquisitions.
We're actively looking," he said, adding that the group also had ambitions to move to a main market listing.
The company's shares rose 10 pence to 285 pence.
